integrationBlueprint.frontend: Read-only education directory; never hold API credentials
integrationBlueprint.backend: Authorized HTTPS API gateway with per-provider credential vault, least privilege, rate limiting, audit logs and token rotation
integrationBlueprint.inventory: Once authorized, sync inventory server-side using provider-supported incremental updates; display last-synced timestamps
integrationBlueprint.webhooks: Only enable authenticated verified callbacks after partner approval; validate source and idempotency
integrationBlueprint.checkout: Disabled until licensing, age/identity verification, delivery permissions and payment legality independently established
integrationBlueprint.digitalAssets: No blockchain wallet, token or cannabis payment flows enabled
integrationBlueprint.menuFeed: POSaBIT menu feeds document Bearer API token plus feed key; unlike general v3 endpoints, do not assume one authentication scheme applies to every endpoint. Store tokens server-side; stage with provider authorization.
integrationBlueprint.aiAgent: Use server-side agent runtime, allowlisted tools, human review for consequential actions and zero customer data sent to unapproved AI services.
productionReadiness: Approved vendor contracts and licensed operations
Server-side secrets with scoped credentials and rotation
Explicit permission checks and audit trails
Compliance and age verification before any commerce
No production deploy without staging smoke tests and coordinated release
